let rec insert (x : Int) (ys : List Int) : List Int :=
      match ys with
      | []      => [x]
      | y :: ys' =>
        if x <= y then
          x :: y :: ys'
        else
          y :: insert x ys'

    let rec sort (arr : List Int) : List Int :=
      match arr with
      | []      => []
      | x :: xs => insert x (sort xs)

    sort xs
